preload.memory_exclusions: Python object overhead, HDF5 internals, model/GPU storage and result receipts

timing_note: Legacy responses include failed acknowledgements; valid all-object TTC distributions are separate in latency_populations. No division by object count.

latency_populations.note: Success is valid all-object output, not parity admission. Failed acknowledgements are not TTC completions. Drops have no inferred latency.
